# Vendored libraries (direction C prototype)

Self-hosted copies, no CDN at runtime. Downloaded from the npm registry on 2026-11-22.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gsap.min.js` | gsap | 3.15.1 | GreenSock Standard "no charge" licence, free for commercial use: https://gsap.com/standard-license (named in the package's `package.json` and README; no separate licence file ships in the npm package) |
| `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | gsap | 3.15.1 | same as above |
| `SplitText.min.js` | gsap | 3.15.1 | same as above |
| `lenis.min.js` | lenis | 1.3.27 | MIT, see `LICENSE-lenis.txt` |

The WebGL light field is hand-written raw WebGL (`js/field.js`); no 3D library is used.
